name: DELTARUNE
_note: The 30 trophies of the PS4/PS5 version. The Switch game has their code but never unlocks them: tools/deltarune (UndertaleModTool patch, LayeredFS) turns it on and saves each unlock as global.flag[2400 + id]. Without the patch, only the trophies the save shows anyway unlock (chapter ends and a few others, see _source).
